# Jubilees Chapter 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Noah's Offerings; Covenant; Blood Prohibition; 364-Day Calendar

---

**6:1** On the first day of the third month, Noah stepped out of the ark. He built an altar on that mountain, called on the name of the LORD, and prayed: "LORD God of our ancestors — don't turn away from the children of Noah, from Shem's line. Keep Japheth close to you. May God make his home in Shem's tents, and may Canaan serve him — a servant to his brothers."

**6:2** That day he offered a burnt offering to the LORD from the clean animals and birds: a male goat as a purification offering, a calf, a sheep, a dove, and a turtledove as burnt offerings, with salt.

**6:3** He placed it all on the altar with the salt and drizzled a quarter hin of oil over it.

**6:4** Noah offered this as a fragrant offering, and it was pleasing before the LORD. God inhaled the sweet smell.

**6:5** The LORD said to him: "Build altars wherever you settle, and consecrate them — the sweet fragrance will always be welcome to me, from now through every generation. I will not make the earth over again."

**6:6** "But make absolutely sure you never eat blood. Here is my command: You must not eat the blood of any creature — not animals, not birds, not anything living on land, in water, or in the air."

**6:7** "If you eat blood, it will bring a curse on you. Anyone who eats the blood of any creature — life is in the blood — that person will die."

**6:8** "And whoever sheds a human life: that person's blood will be shed by another human, because God made human beings in his own image."

**6:9** "Now go — fill the earth."

**6:10** Noah and his sons took an oath that they would never eat blood in any form. He entered into a permanent covenant before the LORD God that month — binding for all generations on earth.

**6:11** That is why God spoke to you, Moses: to make a covenant with the Israelites on this mountain in this same month, ratified by oath and sealed with blood — because of all the covenant terms the LORD established with them forever.

**6:12** This testimony is recorded for you to follow without fail: never eat the blood of any animal, bird, or livestock — not on any day, for as long as the earth lasts. Anyone who does — they and all their descendants — will be cut off from the earth completely.

**6:13** Command Israel: no blood, ever. So that their name and their line may stand before the LORD our God always.

**6:14** This law never expires — it is eternal. Every generation must keep it, so that they can approach the LORD our God in prayer, bringing the blood of their offerings to the altar. Every day an offering goes up, there is atonement for us — because we do not eat the blood.

**6:15** I gave this commandment to Noah's descendants and to all flesh: never retain blood inside the body — pour it out on the ground and cover it with soil.

**6:16** So I commanded Israel: any hunter who takes an animal, bird, or fish must pour out its blood and cover it with earth.

**6:17** Life is in the blood. That is why I told Israel: don't hold the blood back — pour it on the ground and cover it with dust. This is the law and ordinance for Israel.

**6:18** This law never expires. It is for all generations, so that they can make their offerings before the LORD our God.

**6:19** In the third month, in its first week, even before Noah's time, this covenant was established — decreeing that a flood would come in the year the covenant was broken. Noah had sworn on the throne of the LORD that he would never alter the covenant.

**6:20** That is why God commanded them, on the first of the third month, to fast, to humble themselves, and to offer a burnt offering to the LORD. This was the Feast of Weeks — also the Feast of First Fruits. It had a double meaning and a double nature, exactly as written and engraved on the heavenly tablets.

**6:21** That is why the heavenly tablets decree that the Feast of Weeks must be kept in this month once a year, as a covenant renewal ceremony every year without fail.

**6:22** This festival had been observed in heaven from the day of creation all the way to Noah — twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years. Noah and his sons kept it for seven jubilees and a week of years, until Noah died. After his death, his sons abandoned it and began eating blood. That pattern continued until Abraham's time.

**6:23** Abraham alone kept the feast. Isaac and Jacob and his children continued it down to your time, Moses. But in the generation before yours, Israel forgot it — until you renewed it here on this mountain.

**6:24** So command Israel to observe this feast in every generation as a standing law: one day a year in the third month — the Feast of Weeks, the Feast of First Fruits.

**6:25** The feast is double in nature: it marks the first fruits of the harvest and it renews the covenant. Both purposes are fixed into it. Every year Israel must remember and renew the covenant in the third month.

**6:26** The year has exactly three hundred and sixty-four days. Divide them by weeks: fifty-two complete weeks. Three hundred and sixty-four days — a complete year, no more, no less.

**6:27** The heavenly tablets ordain and engrave this as the testimony of the years. No one may skip it — not in any single year, not from year to year.

**6:28** Command Israel to follow this calendar — three hundred and sixty-four days make a full year. Do not shift the appointed times from their proper days or their festivals. Everything unfolds according to the testimony of the calendar. No day is left out, no festival is moved.

**6:29** But if they abandon it and refuse to keep the calendar as commanded, they will knock all their seasons out of order. The years will collapse into chaos. Their appointed times will be forgotten.

**6:30** Israel will lose track entirely — forget the calendar of years, forget new moons, seasons, sabbaths. The whole order of time will unravel for them.

**6:31** I'm telling you now, because I know what's coming: Israel will abandon this calendar. They will adopt the Gentile reckoning. They will go astray on new moons, seasons, and sabbaths. And they will eat blood with their meat.

**6:32** A party will arise that follows the moon — watching how it disrupts the calendar and arrives two days early — and they will base their year on that instead.

**6:33** They will insist: "The moon is the clock." They will mislead even those who are trying to count correctly, and those people will be written off as wrong.

**6:34** And they will call the seven-week count "Weeks of Years" — meaning "Jubilees" — seven times over.

**6:35** That concludes the account of the calendar divisions.

---
*PNEUMA notes: The blood prohibition (vv.6-18) rendered with modern clarity while preserving the legal repetitions. The 364-day solar calendar polemic (vv.26-34) is the ideological heart of Jubilees — rendered to make the sectarian debate clear. "Covenant renewal" for the Feast of Weeks (vv.21-25) is explicit in the text.*
